items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Leonard Feather had hired Big Sid Catlett and I to do a record date during the band to accompany Linda Keene

ctx.x:
showed up. We had done a night's work already.
So we got back. I went to my job. I was sitting in
the dressing room trying to dry off. Try to get myself present-
able for the bandstand. But her gowns was in her dressing room,
so she didn't have any problem changing, you know.

So the next fiasco that she and I had, the big one,
was down at the Vanguard with Leonard Feather had hired Big Sid Catlett
and I to do a record date during the band to accompany
Linda Keene, a Dixieland Blues singer and Avery Parrish was the
piano player. All he knew how to play was 'After Hours' because
he was as nutty as a fruitcake. Someone had hit him in the
head with a barstool out here and had knocked his brains loose,
you know.

He was doing good to be alive. In fact it had depres-
sed his brain and he had to have a plate put in his head and he
had to learn how to play 'After Hours' all over again. He was on
the date. Now, Ben got his price for the date, Sid come to an
agreement on his, mine was supposed to be confirmed, how much
I was going to make for the date because we had to ask for more
than what we had been charging, you know, because Sid was making
a pretty good salary where we were working. Ben was making sec-
ond salary, and I…
